"use strict";
const urlencoded = require("./urlencoded");
const URLSearchParams = require("./URLSearchParams");
const URL = require("./URL");

const native = globalThis.__convexWasmNativeUrl;
if (native === undefined || !Object.isFrozen(native) ||
    typeof native.parse !== "function" || typeof native.get !== "function" ||
    typeof native.set !== "function") {
  throw new Error("Native URL bootstrap is unavailable or invalid");
}
delete globalThis.__convexWasmNativeUrl;
if (Object.hasOwn(globalThis, "__convexWasmNativeUrl")) {
  throw new Error("Native URL bootstrap was not removed");
}

exports.implementation = class URLImpl {
  constructor(globalObject, [url, base], privateData) {
    this._handle = privateData.nativeHandle === undefined
      ? native.parse(url, base) : privateData.nativeHandle;
    if (this._handle === null) throw new TypeError("Invalid URL or base URL");
    this._query = URLSearchParams.createImpl(globalObject,
      [native.get(this._handle, 9).slice(1)], { doNotStripQMark: true });
    this._query._url = this;
    // The pinned URLSearchParams implementation updates this query slot. Keep
    // the association live without retaining JavaScript values in native state.
    const owner = this;
    this._url = {
      set query(value) {
        native.set(owner._handle, 9, value === null ? "" : "?" + value);
      }
    };
  }

  static parse(globalObject, url, base) {
    const nativeHandle = native.parse(url, base);
    return nativeHandle === null ? null : URL.createImpl(globalObject, [url, base], { nativeHandle });
  }

  static canParse(url, base) { return native.parse(url, base) !== null; }

  get href() { return native.get(this._handle, 0); }
  set href(value) {
    if (!native.set(this._handle, 0, value)) throw new TypeError("Invalid URL");
    this._query._list = urlencoded.parseUrlencodedString(native.get(this._handle, 9).slice(1));
  }
  get origin() { return native.get(this._handle, 1); }
  get protocol() { return native.get(this._handle, 2); }
  set protocol(value) { native.set(this._handle, 2, value); }
  get username() { return native.get(this._handle, 3); }
  set username(value) { native.set(this._handle, 3, value); }
  get password() { return native.get(this._handle, 4); }
  set password(value) { native.set(this._handle, 4, value); }
  get host() { return native.get(this._handle, 5); }
  set host(value) { native.set(this._handle, 5, value); }
  get hostname() { return native.get(this._handle, 6); }
  set hostname(value) { native.set(this._handle, 6, value); }
  get port() { return native.get(this._handle, 7); }
  set port(value) { native.set(this._handle, 7, value); }
  get pathname() { return native.get(this._handle, 8); }
  set pathname(value) { native.set(this._handle, 8, value); }
  get search() { return native.get(this._handle, 9); }
  set search(value) {
    native.set(this._handle, 9, value);
    this._query._list = urlencoded.parseUrlencodedString(native.get(this._handle, 9).slice(1));
  }
  get hash() { return native.get(this._handle, 10); }
  set hash(value) { native.set(this._handle, 10, value); }
  get searchParams() { return this._query; }
  toJSON() { return this.href; }
};
